volume.tooltip: Sets the global synth output level.

warpAAmount.tooltip: Sets base harmonic warp amount for this line.

warpBAmount.tooltip: Sets base harmonic warp amount for this line.

algoBlendA.tooltip: Crossfades between Algo A and Algo B outputs.

algoBlendB.tooltip: Crossfades between Algo A and Algo B outputs.

line1Level.tooltip: Sets base output level for this line.

line2Level.tooltip: Sets base output level for this line.

line1Octave.tooltip: Transposes both lines by octave steps (shared).

line2DetuneFine.tooltip: Fine detune for line 2 in CZ units (±60).

lineSelect.tooltip: Selects which oscillator lines are heard together.

modMode.tooltip: Chooses the interaction mode between oscillator lines.

polyMode.tooltip: Switches between polyphonic and monophonic note allocation.

pmPre.tooltip: Apply phase modulation before warp shaping.

vibratoDelay.tooltip: Delays vibrato onset after note start.

tempoBpm.tooltip: Sets the manual tempo used for BPM-synced modulation when no host transport is driving the synth.

lfoRateMode.tooltip: Switches LFO 1 between free-running hertz mode and BPM-synced division mode.

lfoSyncDivision.tooltip: Chooses the rhythmic division for BPM-synced LFO 1.

lfoSymmetry.tooltip: Skews LFO 1 waveform timing around the midpoint.

lfo2RateMode.tooltip: Switches LFO 2 between free-running hertz mode and BPM-synced division mode.

lfo2SyncDivision.tooltip: Chooses the rhythmic division for BPM-synced LFO 2.

lfo2Symmetry.tooltip: Skews LFO 2 waveform timing around the midpoint.

randomRate.tooltip: Sets sample-and-hold random modulation refresh rate.

modEnvSustain.tooltip: Sets sustained modulation level while note is held.

modEnvRelease.tooltip: Sets modulation envelope release time after note off.

filterResonance.tooltip: Boosts frequencies around the cutoff point.

filterEnvAmount.tooltip: Applies envelope modulation amount to the cutoff.

chorusDepth.tooltip: Sets intensity of chorus pitch modulation.

chorusMix.tooltip: Blends dry signal with chorus effect.

delayFeedback.tooltip: Feeds delayed signal back for additional repeats.

delayWarmth.tooltip: Adds tape-style saturation and high-frequency rolloff.

delayMix.tooltip: Blends dry signal with delayed signal.

delayTapeMode.tooltip: Toggle tape echo coloration for delay repeats.

reverbSpace.tooltip: Sets the virtual room size for reverb reflections.

reverbPredelay.tooltip: Adds delay before the reverb tail starts.

reverbDistance.tooltip: Moves source position deeper into the reverb space.

reverbCharacter.tooltip: Shapes reverb tone from dark to bright.

reverbMix.tooltip: Blends dry signal with reverb output.

portamentoMode.tooltip: Chooses whether glide uses rate or fixed time behavior.

portamentoRate.tooltip: Sets glide speed when portamento mode is Rate.

portamentoTime.tooltip: Sets glide duration when portamento mode is Time.

pitchBendRange.tooltip: Sets maximum pitch bend range in semitones.

velocityCurve.tooltip: Shapes how keyboard velocity maps to output level.

modWheelVibratoDepth.tooltip: Sets how much mod wheel movement affects vibrato depth.

lineSelect.L1+L1': Stack line 1 with a detuned variant.
lineSelect.L1+L2': Layer line 1 with a detuned line 2 variant.

modMode.noise: Mix noise source into modulation path.

filterType.lp: Low-pass mode: attenuates frequencies above cutoff.
filterType.hp: High-pass mode: attenuates frequencies below cutoff.
filterType.bp: Band-pass mode: emphasizes a narrow band around cutoff.

portamentoMode.rate: Portamento time scales with note interval distance.
portamentoMode.time: Portamento uses a fixed glide time between notes.

cz101.name: CZ101
cz101.behavior: Classic CZ phase-distortion core. Use DCW and the CZ preset controls to shape the harmonic contour.

preset.label: Preset
preset.description: Loads a predefined CZ waveform and window combination.

waveform1.label: Waveform 1
waveform1.description: Selects the first CZ waveform slot used by the line.

waveform2.label: Waveform 2
waveform2.description: Selects the second CZ waveform slot used by the line.

windowFunction.label: Window Function
windowFunction.description: Chooses the CZ windowing shape applied to the oscillator cycle.

bend.name: Bend
bend.behavior: Bends phase toward one side, adding asymmetry and a brighter edge as depth increases.

bendCurve.label: Curve
bendCurve.description: Changes how aggressively the phase bends along the curve.

bendBias.label: Bias
bendBias.description: Offsets the bend toward the start or end of the cycle.

bendKnee.label: Knee
bendKnee.description: Shapes the transition point between the flatter and steeper bend regions.

sync.name: Sync
sync.behavior: Applies hard-sync style phase resets for harmonic-rich, edgy tones.

syncRatio.label: Ratio
syncRatio.description: Sets how many internal sync resets occur within one cycle.

syncPhase.label: Phase
syncPhase.description: Offsets where the sync restart begins inside the cycle.

syncCurve.label: Curve
syncCurve.description: Shapes the post-sync ramp after each internal reset.

syncWindow.label: Window
syncWindow.description: Controls how strongly the sync-shaped phase replaces the original phase.

pinch.name: Pinch
pinch.behavior: Compresses phase around the center, emphasizing mid-cycle detail and nasal character.

pinchFocus.label: Focus
pinchFocus.description: Moves the pinch center toward the start or end of the cycle.

pinchAsym.label: Asym
pinchAsym.description: Adds asymmetry so one side of the pinch shifts more than the other.

pinchCurve.label: Curve
pinchCurve.description: Changes the curvature of the pinched center region.

pinchDrive.label: Drive
pinchDrive.description: Pushes the pinch harder for a tighter, more exaggerated distortion.

fold.name: Fold
fold.behavior: Folds the phase path back on itself for wavefold-style harmonics and sharper timbre.

foldStages.label: Stages
foldStages.description: Sets how many fold passes are applied across the cycle.

foldTilt.label: Tilt
foldTilt.description: Moves the fold pivot toward the start or end of the cycle.

foldSymmetry.label: Symmetry
foldSymmetry.description: Offsets fold balance to make one side of the cycle fold harder than the other.

foldSoftness.label: Softness
foldSoftness.description: Softens each fold pass so the phase wraps less abruptly.

skew.name: Skew
skew.behavior: Tilts phase timing earlier vs later to shift harmonic balance and attack character.

skewBias.label: Bias
skewBias.description: Moves the breakpoint where the skewed ramp changes slope.

skewCurve.label: Curve
skewCurve.description: Adjusts the curvature on both sides of the skew breakpoint.

skewSpread.label: Spread
skewSpread.description: Redistributes how much of the cycle is assigned to each side of the skew.

skewTilt.label: Tilt
skewTilt.description: Tilts the skewed ramp so one side becomes steeper than the other.

quantize.name: Quantize
quantize.behavior: Steps the phase into discrete levels for a digitized, stair-stepped texture.

quantizeAmount.label: Amount
quantizeAmount.description: Sets the overall phase distortion amount for the current algorithm.

quantizeSteps.label: Steps
quantizeSteps.description: Adjusts the curvature on both sides of the skew breakpoint.

quantizeSkew.label: Skew
quantizeSkew.description: Adjusts the curvature on both sides of the skew breakpoint.

twist.name: Twist
twist.behavior: Applies sinusoidal phase twisting for animated, swirling harmonic motion.

twistHarmonics.label: Harm
twistHarmonics.description: Sets the internal modulation harmonic used to twist the phase.

twistDepth.label: Depth
twistDepth.description: Controls how far the phase is displaced by the twist modulator.

twistPhase.label: Phase
twistPhase.description: Offsets the phase of the internal twist modulation signal.

twistShape.label: Shape
twistShape.description: Changes the contour of the twist modulation from smooth to sharp.

clip.name: Clip
clip.behavior: Limits phase excursion, flattening peaks for a harder, clipped tone.

clipDrive.label: Drive
clipDrive.description: Increases the gain before clipping for a stronger flattened peak.

clipShape.label: Shape
clipShape.description: Sets the clip threshold width from narrow to wide.

clipBias.label: Bias
clipBias.description: Offsets the clipped region toward the start or end of the cycle.

clipSoft.label: Soft
clipSoft.description: Blends from hard clipping into a softer rounded saturation.

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.behavior: Adds high-frequency ripple to the phase trajectory for fine, buzzy harmonic detail.

rippleFreq.label: Freq
rippleFreq.description: Sets how many ripple oscillations appear across the cycle.

rippleDepth.label: Depth
rippleDepth.description: Controls the amplitude of the ripple imposed on the phase.

ripplePhase.label: Phase
ripplePhase.description: Offsets where the ripple pattern begins inside the cycle.

rippleShape.label: Shape
rippleShape.description: Changes the ripple from a smooth sine to a sharper contour.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.behavior: Blends toward an inverted phase path to create mirrored, symmetrical timbres.

mirrorCenter.label: Center
mirrorCenter.description: Chooses the pivot around which the phase is mirrored.

mirrorBlend.label: Blend
mirrorBlend.description: Controls how strongly the mirrored phase replaces the original phase.

mirrorClip.label: Clip
mirrorClip.description: Clamps the mirrored excursion for a tighter folded reflection.

mirrorSkew.label: Skew
mirrorSkew.description: Skews the mirrored side so reflection distance changes across the cycle.

karpunk.name: Karpunk
karpunk.behavior: Plucked/resonant distortion character with decaying inharmonic overtones.

karpunkDamp.label: Damp
karpunkDamp.description: Controls how quickly high-frequency energy is damped in the string model.

karpunkBright.label: Bright
karpunkBright.description: Adjusts the brightness of the feedback filter inside the string loop.

karpunkDecay.label: Decay
karpunkDecay.description: Sets how long the plucked string sustains before fading out.

karpunkExcite.label: Excite
karpunkExcite.description: Injects fresh noise into the delay line for a noisier or raspier pluck.

fof.name: FOF
fof.behavior: Formant-like shaping with windowed resonant emphasis suited to vocal-style colors.

fofRatio.label: Ratio
fofRatio.description: Sets the internal carrier multiplier used for the formant-like repetition.

fofTightness.label: Tight
fofTightness.description: Narrows or widens the Gaussian-like formant window.

fofOffset.label: Offset
fofOffset.description: Offsets the repeated carrier phase before the formant window is applied.

fofSkew.label: Skew
fofSkew.description: Moves the center of the formant window toward the start or end of the cycle.

sine.name: Sine
sine.behavior: Pure sine phase path with minimal harmonics and smooth tone.

terrain.name: Terrain
terrain.behavior: FM-inside-PD: a secondary oscillator displaces the phase path, producing FM-like sideband spectra through the PD engine.

terrainRatio.label: Ratio
terrainRatio.description: Sets the frequency ratio of the phase-modulating oscillator (1–8).

terrainDepth.label: Depth
terrainDepth.description: Controls how far the modulator displaces the phase path.

terrainFmPhase.label: FM Phase
terrainFmPhase.description: Offsets the modulator's start phase within the cycle.

terrainShape.label: Shape
terrainShape.description: Morphs the modulator waveform from a sine (0) to a sawtooth (1).

stutter.name: Stutter
stutter.behavior: Splits the cycle into segments and plays alternating ones backwards, creating glitchy, asymmetric timbres.

stutterSegs.label: Segs
stutterSegs.description: Number of equal segments the cycle is split into (2–8).

stutterReverse.label: Reverse
stutterReverse.description: Blends alternate segments toward time-reversed playback.

stutterSlip.label: Slip
stutterSlip.description: Adds a cumulative phase slip at each segment boundary.

stutterSpacing.label: Spacing
stutterSpacing.description: Sets how many segments separate each reversed segment (2, 3, or 4).

cheby.name: Cheby
cheby.behavior: Chebyshev polynomial harmonic stacking — integer orders multiply the fundamental cleanly; fractional orders blend adjacent harmonics.

chebyOrder.label: Order
chebyOrder.description: Chebyshev polynomial degree (maps 0→1 to harmonic orders 1→6).

chebyTilt.label: Tilt
chebyTilt.description: Phase-shifts the fold points within the super-cycle for asymmetric spectra.

chebyWarp.label: Warp
chebyWarp.description: Pre-warps the input phase before the polynomial, shifting harmonic peaks.

saw.name: Saw
saw.behavior: Saw transfer shape with a bright, harmonically rich spectrum.

square.name: Square
square.behavior: Square transfer shape emphasizing odd harmonics for hollow tone.

pulse.name: Pulse
pulse.behavior: Pulse transfer shape with a narrow-duty harmonic profile.

null.name: Null
null.behavior: Sparse transfer shape with thin, subdued harmonic content.

sinePulse.name: Sine Pulse
sinePulse.behavior: Hybrid sine/pulse transfer for mixed smooth and buzzy harmonics.

sawPulse.name: Saw Pulse
sawPulse.behavior: Hybrid saw/pulse transfer balancing edge and body.

multiSine.name: Multi Sine
multiSine.behavior: Multi-sine resonant transfer emphasizing vocal-like peaks.

pulse2.name: Pulse 2
pulse2.behavior: Dual-pulse style transfer with hollow, comb-like harmonic spacing.
